info.title: Chainlink ACE Coordinator API
info.description: The Coordinator API is the control plane for ACE. Use it to create and manage all ACE resources for your organization.

put.description: Updates a policy engine's name, description, on-chain deployments, and extractor associations. Adding new chain selectors triggers on-chain deployment of new policy engine contracts. Removing chain selectors deletes the coordinator's record for those chains (the on-chain contracts remain deployed but are no longer tracked or managed). New extractors are registered on all on-chain engines; however, removing extractors is not supported — the extractor set is additive only.

Provide a `name`, the `supported_function_signatures` the extractor handles (e.g. `transfer(address,uint256)`), and the `outputs` it produces (named parameters with their Solidity types). Optionally include `onchain_extractors` to record the addresses of already-deployed extractor contracts on specific chains — the coordinator does not deploy extractor contracts; it records their on-chain locations.

post.description: Creates a protection that binds a policy instance to a specific function selector on the target, and triggers on-chain registration (`AddPolicy`) on each specified chain. Provide `function_signature`, `policy_instance_id`, `extractor_output_ids` (mapping extractor outputs to the policy's run parameters), and `desired_position` (evaluation order — position 0 is evaluated first). Each on-chain protection starts in `creation_pending` status. The combination of policy instance, target, and function selector must be unique.

get.description: Retrieve a single identity by its UUID. Returns the identity with its title, entity ID, CCID, registry association, per-chain on-chain details, and archive status.

patch.description: Dual-purpose endpoint: pass `status=archived` to archive the identity, OR pass update fields (`title`, `description`, `onchain_identities`) to update it. The two modes are mutually exclusive. An archived identity cannot be updated or re-archived.

schema.description:
Either status (to archive) OR update fields (title, description, onchain_identities). Mutually exclusive.
- If status is passed, other fields must not be passed (400).
- If status=archived and identity is already archived, returns 400.
- Only status=archived triggers archive.
- If title, description, or onchain_identities are set, internally calls UpdateIdentity (PUT).

status.description: Set to "archived" to archive. Mutually exclusive with update fields.

title.description: Human-readable title. Mutually exclusive with status.

description.description: Description of the identity. Mutually exclusive with status.

onchain_identities.description: Onchain identities to register. Mutually exclusive with status.

202.description: Request accepted. Returns identity when update fields are used; identity when archived.

archived_at.description: Unix timestamp when the identity was archived (null if not archived)

post.description: Registers a new credential for an identity. Requires `credential_type_id` and `identity_id`. Optionally set `external_unique_id` (external system reference) and `expires_at` (Unix timestamp). The credential is deployed on-chain to all chains where the identity's registry exists. Each identity can have only one credential per credential type.

put.description: Updates a credential's `external_unique_id` and/or `expires_at` fields. The credential type and identity association cannot be changed after creation. On-chain expiration is updated to match.

patch.description: Dual-purpose endpoint: pass `status=archived` to archive, OR pass `external_unique_id`/`expires_at` to update. The two modes are mutually exclusive. Archive triggers on-chain credential removal.

schema.description:
Either status (to archive) OR update fields (external_unique_id, expires_at). Mutually exclusive.
- If status is passed, other fields must not be passed (400).
- If status=archived and credential is already archived, returns 400.
- Only status=archived triggers archive; status=active is invalid for PATCH.
- If external_unique_id or expires_at are set, reuses update logic.

post.description: Creates ACE signer wallets used by the coordinator to submit on-chain transactions on behalf of the organization. Requires an active ACE KMS signer, which is provisioned by Chainlink during onboarding. Provide `owner_address` and `chain_selector` for each wallet — the coordinator provisions an ECDSA wallet and returns the deployed `wallet_address`. Each wallet starts in `creation_pending` status. One wallet per org per chain.
